verdicts.reason: A: the photo is cropped to just a mouth and cheek, and the bulb, question-mark, atom and arrow doodles are piled on top of the face, which looks like an unintended collision. Its large headline with the subtitle beside it does read well left to right. B: the same unflattering mouth crop, but the doodles sit in clear space beside the text, which is cleaner. Its downsides are a much smaller stacked headline, a clipped arrow on the left edge and a molecule cut off at the right edge, plus a large empty grey gap between the text and the molecule.
